battle.name: 土耳其獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 1919年5月，協約國准許希臘軍於伊茲密爾登陸並向西內陸推進，引發安納托利亞各地的土耳其民族主義抵抗。穆斯塔法·凱末爾於薩姆松登陸後號召成立大國民議會軍，先後於第一次與第二次伊諾努戰役、薩卡里亞河戰役中以步槍與機槍火力遏制希軍推進，最終於1922年大攻勢將希軍逐出安納托利亞，並於1923年建立土耳其共和國。

kit.name: Gew 88步槍
kit.history: 德國於1888年定型的委員會步槍，後續由德軍以Gew 98替換後大量軍援鄂圖曼帝國。鄂圖曼軍於一戰結束後將其移交土耳其國民軍，土耳其共和國成立後繼續改良使用，服役期延伸至1940年代前後，於土耳其獨立戰爭期間為民族主義部隊可見的制式栓動步槍之一。

countries: 1919 年至 1923 年的土耳其獨立戰爭，鄂圖曼帝國仍是形式上的宗主國，然而其軍隊已由新成立的大國民議會（ Türkiye Büyük Millet Meclisi）指揮。與此同時，希臘遠征軍在伊茲米爾登陸，試圖佔據西海岸；亞美尼亞志願軍在東部山區展開軍事行動；法國與英國則在南部海岸和黑海港口部署兵力，執行物資與情報支援。意大利的少量艦隊亦在安塔利亞海域巡邏，試圖保護其在意屬黎凡特的利益。上述外國軍隊的介入，使得戰場呈現多國兵力交錯的局面，並迫使土耳其民族主義者必須在多條戰線上同時抵禦外敵。
countriesEn: The Turkish War of Independence, fought from 1919 to 1923, involved the Ottoman Empire—still the nominal sovereign—alongside the newly formed Turkish Grand National Assembly (TBMM). The Greek Expeditionary Force landed at İzmir, aiming to occupy the western coast; Armenian volunteers operated in the eastern highlands; France and the United Kingdom deployed troops along the southern coast and Black Sea ports, providing material and intelligence support; a small Italian squadron patrolled the Antalya waters to protect its Levantine interests. This multinational intervention created a complex battlefield where Turkish nationalists were forced to resist foreign forces on multiple fronts simultaneously.
people: 這場運動的核心人物為穆斯塔法·凱末爾·阿塔圖爾克（Mustafa Kemal Atatürk），他於 1919 年 5 月 19 日在薩姆松登陸後，立即組織「安卡拉代表大會」並成立大國民議會。主要的軍事指揮官包括卡茲姆·卡拉貝克爾（Kâzım Karabekir）率領東部兵團在卡爾斯與阿爾特溫一帶抵抗亞美尼亞軍；阿里·富阿特·切貝索伊（Ali Fuat Cebesoy）負責中部與西部的鐵路防禦與游擊行動；以及拉烏夫·奈迪姆（Rauf Orbay）在海軍與后勤方面協調資源。另外，恩維爾·帕夏（Enver Pasha）等舊鄂圖曼軍官亦在外交與情報領域提供支援，形成以阿塔圖爾克為首的統合指挥體系。
peopleEn: Central to the movement was Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, who landed at Samsun on 19 May 1919 and immediately convened the Erzurum Congress before forming the TBMM. Key commanders included Kâzım Karabekir, who led the Eastern Army Group in the Kars‑Ardahan region to contain Armenian forces; Ali Fuat Cebesoy, responsible for the central and western railways and guerrilla operations; and Rauf Orbay, who coordinated naval supply lines. Former Ottoman officers such as Enver Pasha contributed diplomatic and intelligence work. This leadership structure, with Atatürk at its apex, enabled unified command across the various fronts.
kits: 雙方投入的武器皆屬一次大戰時期已列裝的型號。鄂圖曼步兵主要配備馬術步槍（M1898 德制毛瑟步槍的本地改型）與 7.92×57mm 子彈，並使用德製 MG‑08 馬克沁重機槍與英製劉易斯輕機槍提供火力支援。希臘遠征軍則裝備法國勒貝爾 M1886 步槍、馬克沁 M1914 機槍以及 75mm 施奈德野戰炮，另有英製 18 磅炮與意製 65mm 山炮用於山地作戰。亞美尼亞兵力則使用俄制莫辛‑納甘步槍與少許馬克沁機槍，並配備少量 76mm 火炮。法國與英國在海上則派遣驅逐艦配備 4 英吋炮與 6 磅炮，提供海岸火力压制。上述武器均為 1919 年前已量產的型號，符合裝備真實性要求。
kitsEn: The weapons employed were all models already in service before or during World War I. Ottoman infantry were equipped mainly with the Turkish‑produced Mauser Model 1898 rifle firing 7.92×57 mm ammunition, supplemented by German MG‑08 Maxim heavy machine guns and British Lewis light machine guns for fire support. The Greek expeditionary force used French Lebel M1886 rifles, Hotchkiss M1914 machine guns, and 75 mm Schneider field guns, together with British 18‑pounder guns and Italian 65 mm mountain guns for hill warfare. Armenian units were armed with Russian Mosin‑Nagant rifles and a few Maxim guns, plus a handful of 76 mm artillery pieces. French and British warships carried 4‑inch and 6‑pounder guns to provide coastal fire support. All these armaments were already mass‑produced before 1919, satisfying the requirement for authentic equipment.
tactics: 面對多條戰線的威脅，土耳其民族主義者採取了靈活多變的戰術。首先，在東部的卡爾斯—阿爾特溫高原，軍隊以山地防禦工事與遊擊隊相結合，利用地形劣勢消耗亞美尼亞兵力。其次，在中部與西部，利用鐵路沿線的快速機動，組織摩托化縱隊與騎兵相结合，實施側翼包圍與突破。針對希臘步兵的正面進攻，指揮部在伊尼尼Ü（İnönü）與薩卡里亞（Sakarya）等要點構築土木堡壘，配以重機槍與炮兵火力，形成密集的火力網。海上方面，則動員小型炮艇與岸防炮，對敵軍登陸點實施限時轟炸，干擾其後勤补给。整體而言，運動的軍事策略強調快速反應、兵種協同與根據地自给自足的後勤體系。
tacticsEn: Faced with threats on several fronts, Turkish nationalists adopted flexible and varied tactics. In the east, on the Kars‑Ardahan plateau, they combined mountain fortifications with guerrilla bands, using difficult terrain to wear down Armenian forces. In the centre and west, they exploited the railways for rapid mechanised and cavalry thrusts, executing flanking maneuvers and breakthroughs. To counter Greek infantry assaults, commanders fortified key positions such as İnönü and Sakarya with earthwork redoubts, emplacing heavy machine guns and artillery to create dense fire nets. At sea, small gunboats and coastal artillery were mobilized to harass enemy landing sites with timed bombardments, disrupting their logistics. Overall, the military strategy emphasized swift reaction, joint‑arms coordination, and a self‑sufficient supply system based on local resources.
data: 以下是戰爭期間的重要時間節點與兵力部署。1919 年 5 月 19 日，穆斯塔法·凱末爾在黑海港口薩姆松登陸，標誌著民族抵抗的正式開始。1920 年 1 月，大國民議會正式成立，並於 4 月在安卡拉設立臨時政府。此後，1921 年 1 月 10 日至 15 日，伊尼尼Ü第一役爆發，鄂圖曼第 1 兵團與希臘第 3 師在伊尼尼Ü展開激烈交火，雙方投入兵力約 15,000 人；3 月 23 日至 31 日，伊尼尼Ü第二役再次爆發，雙方兵力增至約 20,000 人。1921 年 8 月 23 日至 9 月 13 日，薩卡里亞河谷之戰展開，土耳其集結約 80,000 人對抗希臘約 100,000 人的主力，雙方傷亡慘重。1922 年 8 月 26 日，土耳其發動大反攻，突破希臘防線，9 月 9 日收復伊茲米爾，標誌著希臘軍隊的全線撤退。此時期，後勤線路主要依賴安納托利亞鐵路與黑海沿岸的港口卸貨站，軍需物資包括步槍彈藥、炮彈與醫療用品，均由英法兩國的物資船隻在特定港口進行轉運。
dataEn: The war’s chronology and force dispositions can be outlined as follows. On 19 May 1919 Mustafa Kemal landed at Samsun, marking the official start of national resistance. In January 1920 the TBMM was formally established and in April it set up a provisional government in Ankara. From 10 to 15 January 1921 the First Battle of İnönü erupted; the Ottoman 1st Corps clashed with the Greek 3rd Division, with roughly 15,000 troops on each side. From 23 to 31 March the Second Battle of İnönü flared up, raising the strength on both sides to about 20,000. The decisive Battle of the Sakarya River lasted from 23 August to 13 September 1921, when the Turks concentrated roughly 80,000 men against a Greek force of about 100,000, with heavy losses on both sides. On 26 August 1922 the Turks launched a general counter‑offensive, broke the Greek lines, and on 9 September recovered İzmir, signalling the full Greek retreat. Logistics during this period relied mainly on the Anatolian Railway and Black Sea ports, through which ammunition, artillery shells and medical supplies were trans‑shipped from British and French cargo vessels.
cause: 土耳其獨立戰爭的根本原因可追溯至第一次世界大戰結束後的條約安排。1919 年 8 月 10 日簽署的《色弗爾條約》將鄂圖曼帝國大片領土分割給戰勝國，並允許希臘軍隊在伊茲米爾及其周邊地區進行軍事占領。條約的苛刻條款激起土耳其民族主義者的強烈不滿，要求廢除條約、恢復國家主權。此外，亞美尼亞與法國等國亦在東部與南部展開軍事行動，進一步威脅國家的完整性。在這種外來侵略與內部分裂的雙重壓力下，穆斯塔法·凱末爾等人決定以武力抵抗，組織武裝力量以爭取國際承認與民族自決。
causeEn: The root cause of the Turkish War of Independence traces back to the post‑World War I treaties. The Treaty of Sèvres, signed on 10 August 1919, divided large swaths of Ottoman territory among the victorious powers and authorized a Greek military occupation of İzmir and its hinterland. The harsh terms sparked fierce opposition among Turkish nationalists, who demanded the abrogation of the treaty and the restoration of sovereignty. Meanwhile, Armenian and French forces advanced in the east and south, further threatening the country’s integrity. Under this dual pressure of foreign invasion and internal fragmentation, Mustafa Kemal and his associates resolved to resist by armed force, mobilizing the nation to secure international recognition and the right of self‑determination.
impact: 土耳其獨立戰爭的結果對區域政治格局產生深遠影響。首先，戰爭促使鄂圖曼帝國的崩潰加速，並在 1923 年正式成立土耳其共和國，结束了千年的君主制度。其次，通過《洛桑條約》（1923 年 7 月 24 日），土耳其確立了現代邊界，廢除了外國的治外法權，恢復了經濟主權。第三，戰爭中的軍政合作模式為後續的國家建設提供了模板，凯末尔主義的世俗化、改革化路線在政治、軍事、教育等領域持續發揮作用。對於周邊國家而言，土耳其的成功抵抗展示了弱小民族在外敵入侵下的組織能力，對後續的民族解放運動产生了示範效應。
impactEn: The outcome of the Turkish War of Independence profoundly reshaped the regional political landscape. First, it hastened the collapse of the Ottoman Empire and led to the proclamation of the Republic of Turkey in 1923, ending a thousand‑year monarchic tradition. Second, the Treaty of Lausanne, signed on 24 July 1923, defined modern Turkish borders, abolished foreign capitulations and restored economic sovereignty. Third, the wartime cooperation between military and political leaders set a template for subsequent state‑building; Atatürk’s secular reform agenda permeated politics, the armed forces, education and law. For neighboring states, Turkey’s successful resistance demonstrated that a small nation could organize effective opposition to foreign aggression, providing a model for later nationalist liberation movements across the Middle East and beyond.
result: 最終，土耳其獨立戰爭於 1922 年 9 月結束，武裝衝突停火後進入外交談判階段。1923 年 7 月 24 日，土耳其與盟國簽署《洛桑條約》，正式承認土耳其的獨立與新邊界，並廢除《色弗爾條約》的所有條款。同年 10 月 29 日，土耳其共和國宣告成立，穆斯塔法·凱末爾當選為首任總統，開始推行一系列西化改革。戰後，軍隊重新編制，裝備更新為更現代化的步槍與火炮，並建立職業化的軍官學校，以確保國防力量的可持續發展。整體而言，土耳其獨立戰爭以民族自決、武裝抵抗與外交勝利相結合，實現了國家的重新獨立與制度轉型。
resultEn: Ultimately, the Turkish War of Independence concluded in September 1922; after the cease‑fire, diplomatic negotiations began. On 24 July 1923 Turkey and the Allied powers signed the Treaty of Lausanne, which formally recognized Turkish independence and its new borders, repealing all provisions of the Treaty of Sèvres. On 29 October of the same year the Republic of Turkey was proclaimed, with Mustafa Kemal Atatürk as its first president, who proceeded to institute sweeping Western‑style reforms. The post‑war army was reorganized, its equipment updated to more modern rifles and artillery, and professional military academies were established to guarantee sustainable national defence. In sum, the Turkish War of Independence, combining national self‑determination, armed resistance and diplomatic victory, achieved the country’s rebirth and a fundamental transformation of its political system.
